claims: No. 2 seed Purdue defeated No. 11 seed Texas 79-77.
The game was in the 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16.
The game was at the SAP Center in San Jose.
Trey Kaufman-Renn secured the win for Purdue with a game-winning tip-in with 0.7 seconds remaining.
Trey Kaufman-Renn had 20 points for Purdue.
Trey Kaufman-Renn had 8 rebounds for Purdue.
Trey Kaufman-Renn tipped in a missed shot by Braden Smith with 0.7 seconds left.
Texas tied the game at 77-77 with 11.9 seconds remaining.
Purdue advanced to the Elite Eight.
